basis_statement: Ordering is lawful only within one declared order domain key. No queue family may invent tenant-wide or broker-wide FIFO semantics for unrelated work.

notes: Later stage packets may not overtake an earlier packet with the same manifest and stage order domain.
Distinct manifests and stage codes may execute concurrently.
Authority transport ordering stays narrow enough to preserve duplicate and collision law without serializing unrelated clients.
Runtime scope ordering must remain frozen and deterministic.
Follow-up reads and ambiguity handling remain serialized only per exact authority interaction lineage.
Reconciliation packets must not collapse separate duplicate buckets into one domain.
Projection refresh remains ordered only inside one manifest and projection family.
Queue loss remains recoverable from persisted manifests, receipts, and audit evidence.
Recovery coordination remains serialized only within one attempt lineage and recovery job class.
Stale reclaim and restore verification reuse durable checkpoint truth rather than broker silence.

source_lineage.rationale: Ordering may be enforced only within order_domain_key and recommended domain formulas.
source_lineage.source_heading_or_logical_block: Concurrency and modernization rules for all remaining phases

source_lineage.rationale: Start-claim and recovery cannot infer safety from queue absence alone.
